content:
The corrected quadratic is
\[
25x^2+60x-45=0 \implies 5x^2+12x-9=0.
\]
Solving:
\[
x=\frac{-12\pm 18}{10}\implies x=-3 \text{ or } x=\frac35.
\]
Corresponding \(y\)-values:
\[
x=-3\Rightarrow y=1,\qquad x=\frac35\Rightarrow y=\frac{29}{5}.
\]
So \(A=(-3,1)\), \(B=(\frac35,\frac{29}{5})\).

The chord length is
\[
|AB|=\sqrt{\left(\frac{18}{5}\right)^2+\left(\frac{24}{5}\right)^2}=6.
\]
The distance from the circle center \((2,1)\) to line \(l\) is
\[
\frac{|4(2)-3(1)+15|}{5}=\frac{20}{5}=4.
\]
The farthest distance from any point on the circle to line \(l\) is
\[
4+5=9.
\]
Thus the maximum area is
\[
\frac12 \cdot |AB| \cdot 9 = \frac12 \cdot 6 \cdot 9 = 27.
\]
\[
\boxed{27}
\]
